title.narrative: Technical Assistance Program for Disaster Risk Financing and Insurance in Caribbean Overseas Countries and Territories

description.narrative: "The objective of the Trust Fund is to enhance long term resilience and adaptation capacity in the Carribean Overseas Countries and Territories (OCTs) to adapt to extreme and recurrent natural eventscomma to the benefit of the most vulnerable. This will be done by supporting the development of innovative disaster risk financing optionscomma capacity building within OCTs on use of existing risk transfer mechanisms like Caribbean Catastrophe Risk Insurance Facility (CCRIF) and working with OCTs to promote informed decision-making on disaster risk financing. The activities undertaken under this Trust Fund will benefit the following OCTs: Anguillacomma Arubacomma St. Barthelemycomma British Virgin Islandscomma Bonairecomma Cayman Islandscomma Curacaocomma Montserratcomma Sabacomma Turks and Caicos Islandscomma St Eustatiuscomma St Maarten."
